shown.message:
I approved `paper-repo` PR #15 (final) at head `3865cb5`.

The one must-fix from my earlier review is fixed. Appendix E now gives the longer-fit numbers for both priors, and they match `dsweep.csv`. The default prior gives 2.22/3.38 on the anchor design and 1.98/3.04 on a uniform design. The wide prior gives 2.11/3.52 and 1.92/3.11. The text also now separates the weak prior (precision 0.1, Appendix D) from the wide prior (precision 0.01).

I didn't recompute the 2.22 and 2.11 figures this turn. My re-aggregation of `dsweep.csv` pooled all benchmarks and splits, so it didn't match the paper's six-benchmark, extrapolation-fold numbers. I relied on my earlier check of those rows.

The built PDF from `3865cb5` has 32 pages. The main text ends before the references on page 10. It has no Type 3 fonts and no unresolved `??`. The commit changed only that one paragraph of `public.tex`, so the tables are unaffected. I didn't re-run the rebuild.

The abstract's 0.88 for the published p-IRT estimator is still one extrapolation fold. I left it as an optional wording point, and it doesn't block approval.

The record is `reviews/final-paper-repo-pr15-head-3865cb5.md`, pushed to internal-review-repo.
